mapper.sql: data_filter_id, data_filter_name, data_filter_en_name, entity_class, table_name, rule_type, rule_config, status, remark, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT df.data_filter_id, df.data_filter_name, df.data_filter_en_name, df.entity_class, df.table_name, df.rule_type, df.rule_config, df.status, df.remark, df.create_by, df.create_time, df.update_by, df.update_time FROM sys_user_role_rela urr INNER JOIN sys_role_perm_rela rpr ON urr.role_id = rpr.role_id INNER JOIN sys_permission p ON rpr.ac_id = p.ac_id INNER JOIN sys_data_filter df ON p.data_filter_id = df.data_filter_id WHERE urr.user_id = #{userId} AND df.status = 0 AND p.data_filter_id IS NOT NULL
